name: Devin (Cognition)

positioning_line: Cursor is your coding agent for building ambitious software.

price_of_comparable_item: Jules in Pro (Google AI Pro, $19.99/mo per third-party source): 100 tasks/day, 15 concurrent; free tier 15 tasks/day, 3 concurrent
what_it_sells: Asynchronous coding agent that works on GitHub repos and opens PRs

what_it_sells: Coding agent whose remote orbs keep working after the laptop closes; orbs wake on events (Linear, CI) or a schedule the agent sets
